name: antigravity-sync-monorepo
description: Antigravity Sync Monorepo — Backend Server + Desktop App + Portal Website

scripts.start: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: './sync-server', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); setTimeout(() => { spawn('npm', ['start'], { cwd: './desktop-app', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); }, 1500);"
